name: Purple Game
source:
Anon looks for Fang to help him in his activity, but finds her preening herself. From her venting, she tells all the problems to Anon. But unexpectedly for both of them, Trish finds them, believing that Anon has done something to Fang, so that she is eventually taken to the infirmary. Will Anon be able to prove his innocence and get Trish to trust him again?

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/SnootGame/comments/1agvi13/new_trish_mod_purple_game_demo/]Reddit[/url]]
translation:
阿农寻找方协助他进行活动，却发现她正在打扮自己。从她的发泄中，她把所有的问题都告诉了阿农。但出乎两人意料的是，崔西找到了他们，认为阿农对方做了什么，最终将她送往医务室。阿农能否证明自己的清白并让崔西再次信任他呢？

[来自[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/SnootGame/comments/1agvi13/new_trish_mod_purple_game_demo/]Reddit[/url]]
